content: make this note into just 3 files in a directory called 'recommendations'. Here are some recommendations I think I might enjoy: BOOKS: The Road by Cormac McCarthy - such a powerful post-apocalyptic story with sparse but beautiful writing. Pachinko by Min Jin Lee - this multi-generational Korean family saga set in Japan completely captivated me. Dune by Frank Herbert - the worldbuilding is incredible and it definitely lives up to its classic status! FILMS: Everything Everywhere All at Once - mind-bending multiverse craziness with surprising emotional depth. Parasite - Bong Joon-ho's masterpiece that brilliantly shifts genres while delivering sharp social commentary. Arrival - thoughtful sci-fi focusing on language and communication rather than typical alien invasion stuff. GAMES: Stardew Valley - impossibly addictive farming sim that's perfect when you need something relaxing and charming. Disco Elysium - unique detective RPG with phenomenal writing that's equal parts philosophical and hilarious. Hollow Knight - gorgeous metroidvania with challenging combat and an atmospheric world that keeps you exploring for hours.
